title: Control flow obfuscation with irreducible loops and self-modifying code
summary: Lean 4 development (no Mathlib) of the mathematics, algorithms and security statements of Morse, Alqaradaghi and Kozsik, "Control flow obfuscation with irreducible loops and self-modifying code": a self-modifying-code solver for 2-SAT and the planted instance generator as an algorithm, the extremal numbers of irreducible loops and multiple-entry edges (the families Kn and Mn), the irreducible-loop transformations of Figures 5 and 6, the Boolean control-flow graphs of AES, and the security statements of Section 5.1 relative to an explicit structural threat model. Two Challenges are submitted…
